PLE %s s，缓冲池数据页 %.1f GB: PLE %s s, buffer pool data pages %.1f GB
PLE 偏低说明内存压力大，检查 max server memory、缺失索引导: A low PLE means heavy memory pressure. Check max server memory, large scans caused by missing indexes, and memory grants.
Pending IO 持续存在说明磁盘跟不上，请排查存储并优化逻辑读最高的语句。: Persistent pending IO means the disk cannot keep up. Investigate the storage and optimize the statements with the most logical reads.
cost threshold for parallelism=5（默认值偏低）: cost threshold for parallelism=5 (default value is too low)
max server memory 未限制: max server memory is not limited
tempdb 数据文件数建议与 CPU 核数（最多 8 个）对齐且大小一致，避免: Match the number of tempdb data files to the CPU core count (up to 8) and keep them the same size to avoid allocation page contention.
优先优化 CPU 消耗最高的语句（补索引、改写、处理参数嗅探）。: Optimize the statements that consume the most CPU first (add indexes, rewrite them, deal with parameter sniffing).
信号等待占比高说明 CPU 在排队，先查 Top CPU SQL，必要时扩容或调: A high signal wait ratio means tasks are queuing for CPU. Check the top CPU SQL first, then add CPU capacity or adjust parallelism if needed.
共 %d 条，按执行次数排序；首位执行 %s 次: %d statements, sorted by execution count; the top one ran %s times
共 %d 条，按累计 CPU 排序；首位累计 CPU %s ms: %d statements, sorted by cumulative CPU; the top one used %s ms of CPU in total
共 %d 条，按累计逻辑读排序；首位 %s 页: %d statements, sorted by cumulative logical reads; the top one has %s pages
共 %d 条；首位平均耗时 %s ms: %d statements; the top one averages %s ms
兼容级别 %d，PAGE_VERIFY %s，AUTO_SHRINK %s，自动: Compatibility level %d, PAGE_VERIFY %s, AUTO_SHRINK %s, auto statistics %s
内存授予等待多时检查大排序 / 哈希语句和统计信息，必要时调整 Resource: When many requests wait for memory grants, check large sort / hash statements and statistics, and adjust Resource Governor if needed.
出现内存转储文件说明实例发生过严重错误，请保存文件并联系厂商分析，同时清理过旧的: Memory dump files mean the instance has hit a serious error. Preserve the files and contact the vendor for analysis, and clean up old dumps.
出现死锁时统一各业务的访问顺序、缩短事务，并检查缺失索引引起的大范围加锁。: When deadlocks occur, make all workloads access objects in the same order, shorten transactions, and check for wide-range locking caused by missing indexes.
可运行队列持续大于 0 表示 CPU 吃紧，请优化高 CPU 的语句或扩容。: A runnable queue that stays above 0 means CPU is under pressure. Optimize high-CPU statements or add CPU capacity.
存在阻塞时先定位根因会话和语句，缩短事务，必要时终止阻塞源会话。: When blocking exists, first locate the root-cause session and statement, shorten the transaction, and terminate the blocking session if necessary.
完整 >7 天告警；FULL 模式日志 >1h 关注、>24h 告警: Full >7 days Alert; log in FULL mode >1h Watch, >24h Alert
平均耗时高的语句优先看执行计划，补索引或改写。: For statements with a high average duration, review the execution plan first, then add indexes or rewrite them.
执行次数最多的语句即使单次很快也会累积成负载，检查是否可以缓存或合并请求。: Statements with the most executions add up to a heavy load even if each run is fast. Check whether results can be cached or requests can be merged.
按核数和内存核对 MAXDOP、cost threshold for paral: Review MAXDOP, cost threshold for parallelism and max server memory against the core count and memory, so that memory cannot be consumed without limit.
数据读 >20ms / 写 >10ms 关注；日志写 >5ms 告警: Data read >20ms / write >10ms Watch; log write >5ms Alert
文件数 = min(核心数, 8) = %d 且大小一致: File count = min(cores, 8) = %d and sizes are equal
文件读写延迟偏高时检查存储性能，并把数据文件、日志文件、tempdb 分到不同磁: When file read/write latency is too high, check storage performance and place data files, log files and tempdb on different disks.
日志备份 从未，日志会持续增长: Log backup never taken, so the log will keep growing
日志备份 距今 %.0f 小时，日志会持续增长: Log backup %.0f hours ago, so the log will keep growing
日志重用等待或 VLF 过多时检查备份与长事务，并按需重建日志文件。: When log reuse is waiting or there are too many VLFs, check backups and long-running transactions, and rebuild the log file if needed.
有数据文件延迟偏高: latency is too high on some data files
查看失败作业的错误信息，修复后重跑，避免备份、索引维护等例行任务长期失败。: Review the error messages of the failed jobs and rerun them after fixing, so that routine tasks such as backups and index maintenance do not keep failing.
百分比增长或增量 <64MB 关注；卷剩余 <10% 告警: Percentage growth or increment <64MB Watch; volume free space <10% Alert
确认已安装受支持的累积更新（CU），版本过旧请规划升级。: Make sure a supported cumulative update (CU) is installed, and plan an upgrade if the version is too old.
结合 Top 等待类型定位瓶颈（CPU、IO、锁、内存授予），再针对性优化。: Use the top wait types to locate the bottleneck (CPU, IO, locks, memory grants), then optimize accordingly.
缓冲池按库占用 Top 10: Top 10 buffer pool usage by database
缓冲池被个别库占满时，评估是否有大扫描，或需要把该库拆到独立实例。: When a few databases fill the buffer pool, check for large scans or consider moving the database to a separate instance.
缺失索引提示仅供参考，评估收益和写入代价后再创建，避免与现有索引重复。: Missing index hints are for reference only. Evaluate the benefit and the write overhead before creating an index, and avoid duplicating existing indexes.
自动关闭、自动收缩、页校验关闭等危险选项请改回推荐值。: Change risky options such as auto close, auto shrink and disabled page verification back to the recommended values.
自动增长建议设为固定大小而不是百分比，并监控磁盘剩余空间。: Set auto-growth to a fixed size rather than a percentage, and monitor the free disk space.
读不到实例信息（sys.dm_os_sys_info 无数据）: Cannot read instance information (sys.dm_os_sys_info returned no data)
超过恢复目标的未备份库请立即补做全备 / 日志备份，并确认备份作业在正常运行。: For databases not backed up within the recovery target, take a full / log backup immediately and confirm that the backup jobs are running normally.
运行时长过短时累计型统计的覆盖窗口很短，结论仅供参考，运行几天后再巡检一次。: When the uptime is short, cumulative statistics cover only a short window and the findings are for reference only. Run the inspection again after a few days.
逻辑读最多的语句通常缺索引，优先优化它们以降低 IO。: Statements with the most logical reads usually lack an index. Optimize them first to reduce IO.
长事务会一直持锁并阻止日志截断，请让应用尽快提交或回滚。: A long-running transaction holds locks and prevents log truncation. Have the application commit or roll back as soon as possible.
长期无读的索引占空间并拖慢写入，确认后再删除，删除前先保留创建脚本。: Indexes that are never read take up space and slow down writes. Confirm before dropping them, and keep the creation script before you drop an index.
；存在百分比增长或增量 <64MB: ; some files use percentage growth or an increment <64MB
